name: Querent's Coin
desc: Start each combat with 1 extra energy on turn 1.
flavor: It lands the same way every time.

name: Sealed Letter
desc: Whenever you draw a Major Arcana, draw 1 more card.
flavor: You have not opened it. Yet.

name: A Bent Key
desc: +5 max HP. Heal 5 at the start of every encounter.
flavor: It opened nothing. It opens everything.

name: Ribbon of Fate
desc: Your first card each turn costs 0.
flavor: A long red thread, frayed at one end.

name: Broken Mirror
desc: +15% chance for cards to draw Reversed. Reversed cards have +1 effect.
flavor: Each shard contains a different you.

name: Wax Mask
flavor: The face you put on before the curtain rises.

name: The Thurible
desc: Heal 2 at the start of each turn.

name: Iron Chalice
desc: When you heal, draw 1 card (max once per turn).

name: Dancer's Bell
desc: After playing 3 cards in a turn, gain 1 energy.

name: Silvered Tooth
desc: Your first attack each combat strikes twice.
flavor: It bit something long ago. It still tastes it.

name: Crooked Lens
desc: See the enemy intent two turns ahead.
flavor: Squint, and the future blurs into focus.

name: A Forgotten Name
desc: Once per combat: when you would die, instead heal to 10 HP.
flavor: Someone is looking for you. They will not find you.

name: Ace of Aces
flavor: The first card in any reading.

name: Fool's Feather
desc: At combat start: shuffle a free copy of The Fool into your hand.
flavor: A pale plume, unwilling to settle.

name: Two of Coins
desc: Whenever you defeat an enemy: gain 5 gold.
flavor: Always one too few, or one too many.
